programme.title: Asia
programme.desc: Sir David Attenborough, who has been bringing viewers the secrets of fauna and flora for almost seven decades, this time takes on the role of a guide to the largest continent on Earth.The film material was shot for almost four years.In seven episodes, documentarians showed from a new perspective the natural riches of Asian mountain ranges, ocean depths, dense jungle and inaccessible caves.They captured a stunning variety of the wildest places - from the frozen land of seals to colorful coral reefs.An ocean teeming with life. The first episode of the series will reveal to viewers the magic of the underwater world.Asia has the longest coastline of all continents and the richest coral reefs on Earth.Its seas are connected by some of the most powerful sea currents in the world.It is home to over sixty percent of all marine species.Specialized cameras recorded, among other things, sharks chasing fish called Moorish idols.In an interview, the filmmakers admitted that this was one of the most difficult sequences to capture.They also visited the remote Seal Islands and the Sea of ​​Japan, where they tracked squid.Finally, they explored the secret world of the Coral Triangle - the richest concentration of marine life on our planet.

World's Most Amazing Walks
programme.desc: Robson Green gained popularity, among others, thanks to the role of an experienced detective in the crime series "Grantchester".Privately, the actor is a great lover of hiking and fishing.The new series documents eight expeditions along selected tourist routes in Europe.The artist traveled, among others, the northern coast of Normandy, following in the footsteps of soldiers taking part in a key battle of World War II.On the Trail of the Eagles' Nests in Poland, he had the opportunity to admire impressive landscapes and the ruins of medieval castles.A monument to a bygone era. Robson Green begins exploring the most beautiful trekking routes in the world in his native Great Britain.Hadrian's Wall is one of the most important monuments of ancient Rome on the Islands.The trail, divided into stages, is 135 kilometers long.It has special meaning for the actor because he grew up in this area.He follows familiar paths through the rugged moors.He has loved this landscape since childhood.He is amazed not only by nature, but also by the heritage of the past.He gets to know, among other things, Vindolanda - a Roman camp built in the 1st century.Archaeologists still make discoveries here related to the times of the Roman Empire.

programme.title: Spy in the Ocean
programme.desc: The creators of the four-episode series present the journey of specially constructed animal replicas equipped with cameras to the ocean.Their goal is to bring closer the deeply hidden life of creatures inhabiting this inaccessible and dynamic ecosystem.Using breakthrough technology, including:modern LCD screens, record surprising behaviors and relationships of sea animals.Viewers will see colorful coral reefs, rocky coastlines, Thai macaques fishing, unusual behavior of seals, socialization of sperm whales and a complicated ritual between hermit crabs.The over thirty spies include a sperm whale, a herring, a puffer, a hermit crab, a clownfish and a dolphin.The production took three years on four oceans of the world.
